discardBody: Your unsaved campaign changes will be lost.
line: Reach the right members with a clear, useful message.
eligibleOnly: Only eligible, subscribed members receive your campaign.
writeHint: Start with one benefit and one clear action. Preview before you continue.
chooseHint: Pick an audience, check who can receive it, then confirm the send.
draftOnly: Draft · saving never sends a message
testHint: Tests go only to your signed-in staff address. The campaign stays a draft.
saveContinue: Save your work or continue to choose the audience.
copyHint: Save a new segment to customize this audience. The original segment stays unchanged.
reviewHint: Consent and eligibility are checked again when you send. Counts may change.
segmentCounts: Segment counts show matching members. Each channel checks consent and reachability separately.
chooseSegment: Select a segment to see its rules.
saveFirst: Save your draft to review the current audience.
channelNote: Channel access depends on your plan and setup.
pushLimit: Push opens the member app. Test push and custom tap destinations are not available here.
cost: The provider bills SMS parts. A price estimate is not available here.
emailRequirements: Email sending is built in. HexaTech must configure the platform mail provider and delivery workers. Your organisation uses this shared service; a campaign list does not confirm live delivery.
customSenderHold: Own sending domain / SMTP · On hold
customSenderDetail: Self-service domain and SMTP connections are not available yet. Sender name and reply-to can be configured; the sending address belongs to the platform.
smsRequirements: Connect your organisation’s own Twilio account and a sender number or Messaging Service in Integrations. Twilio bills your account. Only eligible members with SMS consent can receive campaigns.
pushRequirements: Push requires the member app, platform Apple/Google push credentials and members who allow notifications on registered devices. Browser push and custom app layouts are not available here.
